name: tests-half-goss-property-scoped-resource-validation
instr:
Add property-scoped validation. Preserve existing behaviour.

Parse resource-type:resource-id-pattern:property-pattern selectors without changing component case. Resource ID and property wildcards resolve case-sensitively. Overlapping Command selectors deduplicate properties and execute once; Command results retain ordinary property order regardless of selection order. Classify absent resources as Unmatched and unsupported properties on known resources as Ineligible. Diagnostics retain input order; Unmatched retains repeated occurrences. Configured scopes copy caller-owned selectors.

Addr reachable invokes only its probe and retains resource identity; unsupported Addr properties do no work. Command exit-status, stdout and stderr selections invoke only selected accessors. Failed Command exit-status and DNS resolvable retry RetryCount+1 times and return one failing result; DNS resolvable does not retrieve addrs.

Interface addrs and mtu include exists and omit the other accessor; failed existence skips selected dependents without accessing them. File contents, size and sha256 include exists, retain ordinary result order and succeed for matching files; missing files skip size/sha256. HTTP headers/body include status: failed status skips dependent accessors; successful output properties are "status", "Headers", "Body". Close each created HTTP probe once. Matching supports matches and returns nothing for body. Gossfile scoped execution is resultless and property requests are inel
